fullPassage: When I woke up in our hotel room, it was almost midnight. I didn't see my husband nor daughter. I called them, but I heard their phones ringing in the room. Feeling worried, I went outside and walked down the street, but they were nowhere to be found. When I decided I should ask someone for help, a crowd nearby caught my attention. I approached, hoping to find my husband and daughter, and suddenly I saw two familiar faces. I smiled, feeling calm. Just then, my daughter saw me and called, "Mom!" They were watching the magic show. Finally, I felt all my worries disappear.

사라진 가족을 찾는 과정의 불안은 그들을 안전하게 발견하자 안도로 바뀐다.

questions.passage: When I woke up in our hotel room, it was almost midnight. I didn't see my husband nor daughter. I called them, but I heard their phones ringing in the room. Feeling worried, I went outside and walked down the street, but they were nowhere to be found. When I decided I should ask someone for help, a crowd nearby caught my attention. I approached, hoping to find my husband and daughter, and suddenly I saw two familiar faces. I smiled, feeling calm. Just then, my daughter saw me and called, "Mom!" They were watching the magic show. Finally, __________.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 맞게 영작하시오.

나는 내 모든 걱정이 사라지는 것을 느꼈다.

[조건] (1) all, disappear, felt, I, my, worries를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것 (영어로)

det.korean: I felt all my worries disappear
det.analysis:
본문: 'Finally, I felt all my worries disappear' — 지각동사 felt(feel) + 목적어(all my worries) + 동사원형(disappear)

[조건 검증] I(1) felt(2) all(3) my(4) worries(5) disappear(6) = 6단어

questions.wa: I felt all my worries disappear
accept: I felt all my worries disappear
